p.src: 1  Oh come, let’s sing to the LORD. Let’s shout aloud to the rock of our salvation!

en: Oh come, let’s sing to the LORD. Let’s shout aloud to the rock of our salvation!
u.src: 1  Oh come, let’s sing to the LORD. Let’s shout aloud to the rock of our salvation!

p.src: 2  Let’s come before his presence with thanksgiving. Let’s extol him with songs!

en: Let’s come before his presence with thanksgiving. Let’s extol him with songs!
u.src: 2  Let’s come before his presence with thanksgiving. Let’s extol him with songs!

p.src: 3  For the LORD is a great God, a great King above all gods.

en: For the LORD is a great God, a great King above all gods.
u.src: 3  For the LORD is a great God, a great King above all gods.

p.src: 4  In his hand are the deep places of the earth. The heights of the mountains are also his.

en: In his hand are the deep places of the earth. The heights of the mountains are also his.
u.src: 4  In his hand are the deep places of the earth. The heights of the mountains are also his.

p.src: 5  The sea is his, and he made it. His hands formed the dry land.

en: The sea is his, and he made it. His hands formed the dry land.
u.src: 5  The sea is his, and he made it. His hands formed the dry land.

p.src: 6  Oh come, let’s worship and bow down. Let’s kneel before the LORD, our Maker,

en: Oh come, let’s worship and bow down. Let’s kneel before the LORD, our Maker,
u.src: 6  Oh come, let’s worship and bow down. Let’s kneel before the LORD, our Maker,

p.src: 7  for he is our God. We are the people of his pasture, and the sheep in his care. Today, oh that you would hear his voice!

en: for he is our God. We are the people of his pasture, and the sheep in his care. Today, oh that you would hear his voice!
u.src: 7  for he is our God. We are the people of his pasture, and the sheep in his care. Today, oh that you would hear his voice!

p.src: 8  Don’t harden your heart, as at Meribah, as in the day of Massah in the wilderness,

en: Don’t harden your heart, as at Meribah, as in the day of Massah in the wilderness,
u.src: 8  Don’t harden your heart, as at Meribah, as in the day of Massah in the wilderness,

p.src: 9  when your fathers tempted me, tested me, and saw my work.

en: when your fathers tempted me, tested me, and saw my work.
u.src: 9  when your fathers tempted me, tested me, and saw my work.

p.src: 10  Forty long years I was grieved with that generation, and said, “They are a people who err in their heart. They have not known my ways.”

en: Forty long years I was grieved with that generation, and said, “They are a people who err in their heart. They have not known my ways.”
u.src: 10  Forty long years I was grieved with that generation, and said, “They are a people who err in their heart. They have not known my ways.”

p.src: 11  Therefore I swore in my wrath, “They won’t enter into my rest.”

en: Therefore I swore in my wrath, “They won’t enter into my rest.”
u.src: 11  Therefore I swore in my wrath, “They won’t enter into my rest.”
